about: Shouse Law Group Los Angeles Criminal Defense & DUI Lawyers is a personal injury firm with ten offices across California, including Sherman Oaks, Orange and Van Nuys.

The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 10 listings, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

G1.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search
G1.evidence: 2 of 5 named attorneys hold an active California licence and none carries an adverse status. 3 name(s) could not be told apart from namesakes and are counted neither way

G2.source: the State Bar of California's licensee search, incomplete: an adverse namesake we cannot resolve
G2.evidence: No disciplinary record is held against any of the 2 attorneys we identified. John Murray could not be told apart from 8 namesakes, one of whom is not eligible to practise. Held open.
G2.unresolvable: A namesake carries an adverse status and the register holds no field that would tell the two people apart

G3.evidence: 10 physical locations verified on Google Business Profile. California publishes no business register we are able to query, so the registration itself is not verified here. The state's own business search is the place to check it.

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 5 named attorneys published.
G5.source: Public crawl of the firm's own site

G6.evidence: 841 public client reviews across 10 Google listings, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2004-06-10, so it has been operating for more than a year
G6.source: Google Places API and the domain's registration date over RDAP

logo.source: The icon the firm's own site declares, copied here rather than hot-linked

operating.source: Domain registration date over RDAP, which is a lower bound on how long the firm has been operating rather than its founding date

accountability.evidence: no bar or trial lawyers' association named on the pages we read · no professional liability cover disclosed, which is not scored here: plaintiff firms in this market do not publish it, and an absence shared by every firm separates none of them

results_published.why: the site publishes no case-results page

score.verdict: 3 of 5 eligibility gates passed. 2 could not be answered from the available records (G2, G3) and do not count against the firm. Strongest pillar: C; most headroom in pillar B (0/15).
